artifact_contract.artifact_inventory: artifact_inventory.json binds the byte count and SHA-256 of every derived member, including the common morphology manifest
artifact_contract.common_manifest: morphology_manifest.json binds the exact raw products, source closure, attempt identity, nominal slot, full observed committed time, and common cycle
artifact_contract.serialization: canonical UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, two-space indentation, terminal newline, duplicate-key rejection, and non-finite-number rejection

failure_policy.artifact_validation: fail on missing or additional members, noncanonical JSON, manifest drift, source-product drift, or inventory checksum drift
failure_policy.decoded_mesh_identity: fail unless every decoded mesh product source and cycle exactly matches its raw-artifact binding and the production-science matched-grid contract passes
failure_policy.fixed_profile_grid: fail unless the finest composite grid exactly and uniformly subdivides the preregistered 12 c/omega_pi comparison grid
failure_policy.particle_identity: fail unless exact PVTK scalar/vector inventory, storage layout, product source, nominal slot, full observed committed time, cycle, float32 point representation, retained-domain containment, and positive active CR kinetic energy all pass
failure_policy.raw_artifact_provenance: fail on missing or additional products, relabeled product identity, unsafe or duplicated paths, malformed SHA-256, non-t500 nominal slot, observed-time disagreement, or cycle disagreement

nominal_snapshot_contract.shock_front_convention: unique strongest negative density gradient from the corrected production-science successor; no qualifying-use authority is granted here

predecessor_contracts.role: corrected full-state current particle and shock-physics diagnostic authority
historical source of the fixed 12 c/omega_pi AMR-versus-fine profile comparison rule and t500 morphology requirements; its positive-gradient shock-front rule remains superseded for future use

coordinates: x1 relative to ideal injection surface
x1 relative to separately detected shock front

fields: lab-frame deposited J_CR/c components and magnitude
gas-frame deposited J_CR/c components and magnitude

profile_contract.grid_matching_rule: conservatively equal-area restrict from the finest composite to 12 c/omega_pi in x1 and x2, then average across the full transverse domain

particle_profile.weight: particle macro mass times macro weight times relativistic specific kinetic energy reconstructed from exact decoded float32 PVTK velocity

refinement_profile_and_overlay.overlay: exact x1-x2 rectangle for every retained leaf MeshBlock, colored by physical source refinement level
refinement_profile_and_overlay.profile: full-transverse-area fraction by physical source refinement level on the fixed 12 c/omega_pi x1 grid

scope: Additive fail-closed source-local successor for deterministic publication-bound Section 5.4 morphology profiles at nominal t=500. It produces an energy-weighted active-CR spatial profile, deposited-current lab/gas-frame profiles, magnetic-field and density-context profiles, physical-source-level refinement profiles, and exact leaf-block refinement overlay rectangles. Every derived member binds a common raw/source provenance manifest and a checksummed inventory.
